target_customer: Staffing and recruiting agencies (Bullhorn-style ATS users)
problem: Top-of-funnel recruiting work (sourcing, screening, outreach, drafting submittals) is slow and manual and limits placements per recruiter.
business_model: B2B SaaS for agencies (pricing not found)

founders.name: Rihab Lajmi
founders.background_notes: Cloud and engineering work for Fortune 500 clients in Europe and the US per YC launch post; also an EWOR fellow per ewor.com. Education not verified.

founders.name: Badis Zormati
prior_employers: Infineon Technologies (firmware for MEMS products, AI transformation of hardware solutions)
education: Technical University of Munich, master's degree

competitors.name: Alex
competitors.what: AI recruiter running initial job interviews

competitors.name: Juicebox
competitors.funding_then: 80M USD Series B at 850M USD valuation, 2026-03

technical_complexity.rationale: Voice, SMS and email agents wired into an ATS with each agency's screening logic is applied LLM engineering with integration work.

defensibility.rationale: Per-agency cloning of recruiter knowledge and ATS integrations create some lock-in, but many funded AI recruiting startups and ATS vendors can build similar agents.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Too early; well-funded AI recruiting rivals raised large rounds in 2025 and 2026.

market_need_then: Staffing agencies compete on speed; the company cites a 200B USD industry. The only dated demand evidence found is a May 2026 trade-press interview about doubling placements with agentic AI.

branding.domain_note: Uses asendia.ai; an unrelated international mail company has the name Asendia

brand_strength.rationale: Name collides with an established mail and e-commerce logistics company; no brand press found.

outcome_analysis: Asendia AI is a Spring 2026 YC company selling AI recruiter agents to staffing agencies, with a ten-person team. No verified funding or traction is public, and no outcome exists yet. It enters a category where Alex and Juicebox raised large rounds within the prior year, so differentiation by cloning each agency's best recruiter is the stated bet.
notes: Aggregators conflict on funding (about 500K USD pre-seed per VCBacked vs 1.03M USD per Employbl; investors Superangels, EWOR, Angel Invest, one listing dates a pre-seed to 2024); unverified, not recorded as rounds. Education for Lajmi was reported by aggregators only and is omitted. The 2026-03 Juicebox figure comes from a single trade-press summary. Name origin not found. Unrelated mail company Asendia.
